papers.title: Breakdown of the Migdal-Eliashberg theory for electron-phonon systems: Role of polarons and bipolarons
papers.abstract: The Migdal-Eliashberg theory (MET) describes electrons interacting with phonons at weak/moderate couplings. A conventional belief is that MET holds even at strong coupling, and, for an interaction with an optical phonon, breaks down only near the point where the dressed phonon softens. Here, the authors analyze numerically and analytically a different option — a collapse to a polaronic/bipolaronic ground state. They show in detail how this happens and demonstrate that away from near-half-filling, a polaron/bipolaron state develops well before a dressed phonon softens.

papers.title: Hot carrier localization in continuum states of a quantum dot solid
papers.abstract: Author(s): Ajay K. Poonia, Naresh Aggarwal, Swapnil S. Deshpande, Barnali Mondal, Angshuman Nag, Sudip Chakraborty, and K. V. Adarsh Hot carriers in semiconductors typically cool within a picosecond, dissipating their excess energy as heat. Here, the authors demonstrate that intrinsic positional disorder in a metal halide perovskite quantum dot solid usually treated as a defect of such assemblies, can instead strongly suppress hot-carrier cooling. Ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy reveals hot carriers localized in continuum states, with cooling times more than an order of magnitude longer than those in uncoupled quantum dots. First-principles density functional theory traces this localization to disorder-induced local potential fluctuations.

papers.abstract: The authors utilize phonon fluctuation diagnostics here to resolve the open question of the microscopic origin of charge density wave order in AV3Sb5 (A=K, Rb, Cs) kagome metals. papers.abstract: The Weyl semimetal Mn3Sn hosts a rich sequence of magnetic states. Here, the authors combine muon spin relaxation and magnetization measurements to reveal a broad crossover between helical and inverse triangular antiferromagnetic order. papers.abstract: The Ce pyrochlores Ce2X2O7 (X = Sn, Hf, Zr) have attracted considerable attention as quantum spin ice candidates. papers.title: Tunable superconductivity and spin density waves in ${\mathrm{La}}_{3}{\mathrm{Ni}}_{2}{\mathrm{O}}_{7}/{\mathrm{LaAlO}}_{3}$ thin films
papers.abstract: The authors combine first-principles calculations and singular-mode functional renormalization group to show that the interlayer Ni–Ni distance controls competing orders in La3Ni2O7/LaAlO3 thin films. With increasing distance, the ground state evolves from a C-type spin density wave through s±-wave superconductivity, with pairing dominated by Ni 3d3z2−r2 orbitals, to a G-type spin density wave. The predicted pressure suppression of Tc provides a test of itinerant versus local-moment descriptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles calculations、singular-mode functional renormalization group。；研究对象：La₃Ni₂O₇/LaAlO₃ 薄膜体系，研究其中层间 Ni–Ni 距离对竞争有序态（超导与自旋密度波）的调控，以及压力对 Tc 的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 层间 Ni–Ni 距离控制竞争有序态：随距离增大，基态从 C 型自旋密度波演化为 s± 波超导（配对主要由 Ni 3d_{3z²−r²} 轨道主导），再演化为 G 型自旋密度波；预测压力会抑制 Tc。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：层间 Ni–Ni 距离控制竞争有序态：随距离增大，基态从 C 型自旋密度波演化为 s± 波超导（配对主要由 Ni 3d_{3z²−r²} 轨道主导），再演化为 G 型自旋密度波；预测压力会抑制 Tc。；创新点：揭示了 La₃Ni₂O₇/LaAlO₃ 薄膜中层间 Ni–Ni 距离可作为调控竞争有序态（C 型 SDW → s± 波超导 → G 型 SDW）的参数，并提出压力抑制 Tc 可作为区分巡游电子描述与局域磁矩描述的判据。

papers.title: Corbino-enhanced supersonic acoustic-emission threshold in a GaAs two-dimensional electron system
papers.abstract: Author(s): A. D. Levin, A. S. Jaroshevich, Z. D. Kvon, V. A. Chitta, M. S. Aksenov, D. V. Dmitriev, A. K. Bakarov, and G. M. Gusev Here, the authors show that the Corbino geometry strongly enhances alocal threshold for supersonic acoustic-phonon emission in ahigh-mobility GaAs two-dimensional electron system. Radial currentconcentration drives the electron velocity above the sound velocitynear the inner contact, producing a pronounced nonlinear resistanceanomaly. Its polarity dependence is linked to contact Peltier heatingand cooling, highlighting Corbino devices as sensitive probes andpotential localized sources of nonequilibrium acoustic phonons.

papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段或计算方法（如 DFT+U、DMRG、ARPES 等），仅提及通过非公度范德华异质结的耦合来构建和工程化周期性 Anderson 模型。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems

papers.title: Thermometry for a kagome lattice dipolar Rydberg simulator
papers.abstract: We propose an accurate thermometry approach for Rydberg atom tweezer arrays combining data from correlation and local susceptibility measurements with a theoretical high-temperature expansion method for dynamic spin correlations. papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方法文章（混合类型，含对已有实验数据的分析）。判断依据关键词：propose an accurate thermometry approach、theoretical high-temperature expansion method，同时结合 recent quantum simulation experiment 的数据。；研究对象：Rydberg 原子光镊阵列（tweezer arrays）中的 kagome 晶格偶极 Rydberg 模拟器量子系统，研究其温度/热力学性质的测量问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种精确的测温方法，将关联测量与局域磁化率测量数据，与针对动态自旋关联的高温展开理论方法相结合，可应用于 kagome 晶格偶极 Rydberg 模拟器实验。摘要未明确说明具体的温度数值或物理结论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种精确的测温方法，将关联测量与局域磁化率测量数据，与针对动态自旋关联的高温展开理论方法相结合，可应用于 kagome 晶格偶极 Rydberg 模拟器实验。摘要未明确说明具体的温度数值或物理结论。；创新点：将关联与局域磁化率测量同动态自旋关联的高温展开理论相结合，为 Rydberg 原子光镊阵列提供了一种精确的测温方案。摘要未进一步明确说明相对于已有测温方法的具体改进细节。
papers.method_zh: 结合关联（correlation）测量与局域磁化率（local susceptibility）测量的数据，并采用针对动态自旋关联的高温展开（high-temperature expansion）理论方法；应用于近期 Borne 等人的量子模拟实验。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems
